listing.name: Luddic Enhancement Mod
listing.summary: Due to popular demand, I have split off the IED ships into their own mod. This mod does not need Luddic Enhancement, and Luddic ENhancement does not need this mod. This mod adds IED ships, specifically a dram, a phaeton, and a Prometheus, which explode, taking ships out in the near vicinity.
listing.aiSummary: Adds exploding ship variants that damage nearby vessels upon destruction.

discordPostHtml:
A small mod to enhance the Luddic Church's position in Nexerellin, and enhance Luddic Church and Luddic Path fleets with new, lore-friendly ships.

-Several minor changes to some ship spawning.
-Fixed some missing variants.
Savegame compatible with previous version

Download: https://bitbucket.org/King_Alfonzo/i-will-make-sindria-great-again/downloads/Luddic_Enhancement_1_2_7b.zip
aiDescription: Introduces specific ship models equipped with improvised explosive devices. These ships detonate when destroyed, causing significant damage to surrounding friendly and enemy units.
